name: PV Maine Solar
old_description: Welcome to PV Maine, your local experts in solar panel installation across Downeast Maine and every county in the state. We specialize in custom solar energy solutions for homes and businesses, helping you save money, reduce your carbon footprint, and harness the power of the sun—even through Maine’s unique seasons.
about:
PV Maine Solar is based in Bar Harbor, Maine. The company’s founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed; it operates as a solar installation service provider across the state.

The company designs and installs custom solar photovoltaic systems for homes and businesses, along with battery storage, electric-vehicle charging stations, and ongoing maintenance. Its services cover consultation, system design, installation, activation, and monitoring. No facility size, headcount, or annual volume figures are published.

PV Maine serves residential homeowners and commercial clients throughout Maine, from Hancock County to Aroostook. The firm emphasizes its familiarity with the state’s climate, seasonal conditions, and incentive landscape.

The company cites its local expertise, use of high-quality equipment from trusted manufacturers, experienced installation teams, competitive pricing with financing options, and a commitment to customer service as factors that distinguish it in the market.
